description: S59 T6 (EV12): environment.teardown's success answer is the LEDGER ROW after the driver ran — state removed and removed_at set — and the row SURVIVES. Nothing in this plane deletes the record that a resource existed; a container that came and went still says when it came and when it went, because a ledger you can lose rows from is not evidence. A host-backend provision is refused instead (provision-nothing-to-remove): there was never a resource to remove, and pretending otherwise would put a removal in the audit for an event that never happened.
